subject: Request: Security & Architecture Review — Redwood integration
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@novara.tech>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@novara.tech>, procurement@novara.tech
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Security & Architecture Review request for Redwood integration

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the team at Novara is excited about the integration possibilities. Our security and platform teams would like a short architecture/security review before we move forward with procurement.

High-level asks:
- Walkthrough of data flows (ingress/egress) and retention controls
- Clarification on private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and KMS integration
- SOC 2 evidence and access to any relevant questionnaires

We can do a 45-minute session. Here are our proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-10-13 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2026-10-13 15:00–15:45
- Wed 2026-10-14 09:30–10:15

Attaching our current security questionnaire and a short vendor checklist. Please loop in whoever from your side should join (SE + security).

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: Novara_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@novara.tech>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Architecture Review request for Redwood integration

Alex — thanks for the details and the questionnaire. Looping in Diego (SE) and Mina (security/compliance).

Quick responses to your asks:
- We will prepare a short diagram of data flows and an explanation of retention/KV cache behavior.
- We support both VPC peering and on-prem packages; Mina will explain KMS/HSM options and audit logging.
- I attached a SOC 2 one-pager and our standard security slides to this reply for your team to review beforehand.

For scheduling, Diego and Mina prefer the Wed slot but can make Tue afternoon if needed. If Wed 09:30–10:15 works for you, I can send a calendar invite and include a shared Drive link to the diagram we will present.

Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Jasmine Liu (AE)
- Diego Fernandez (Solutions Engineer)
- Mina Haddad (Security & Compliance)

Thanks — will wait to confirm the slot that fits your team.

Best,
Jasmine

Attachments: SOC2-one-pager.pdf (pdf, 48KB); redwood-security-slides.pptx (pptx, 2.1MB)
From: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@novara.tech>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Alex Cho <alex.cho@novara.tech>
Date: 2026-10-12T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Architecture Review request for Redwood integration

Jasmine — thanks for the rapid reply. Wed 09:30–10:15 PDT works for our security engineers (I'll confirm headcount by EOD Monday). Can you confirm if you need any specific VPN access or a shared environment account for the demo?

Also, procurement asked whether the review can include a short note on expected license/commit timing so they can align internal approvals. If Diego could briefly mention Dedicated/reserved capacity options, that would be helpful.

—Sofia
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@novara.tech>, Alex Cho <alex.cho@novara.tech>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, procurement@novara.tech
Date: 2026-10-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Architecture Review request for Redwood integration

Great — locking Wed 2026-10-14 09:30–10:15 PDT on our side. I just created a calendar hold and included a Google Meet link.

Notes for the session:
- Diego will cover Dedicated vs Hosted deployments and cost/commit considerations (10 min) — procurement welcome to stay for this section.
- Mina will cover SOC 2 controls, KMS/HSM options, and what evidence we can provide for vendor questionnaires (20–25 min).
- We'll reserve 10–15 min for Q&A and any follow-ups/actions.

No VPN or shared account needed for the high-level review; if the Novara team requests a hands-on POC later we can provision a short-lived test environment (we'll handle access controls via temporary API keys).

I'll send the calendar invite now and attach the diagram and slides. Please reply if you need any adjustments to attendees or timing.

-Jasmine

Attachment: calendar invite (Google Calendar)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Alex Cho <alex.cho@novara.tech>, Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@novara.tech>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Architecture Review request for Redwood integration

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's call — Alex/Sofia, thanks for sharing the questionnaire. I've skimmed it and flagged three items we should consider in advance:

1) Data residency: we need to confirm whether Novara requires EU-only residency for any customer data; that will affect deployment recommendations.
2) Audit evidence: I can provide SOC 2 scope and recent date ranges; if Novara needs encrypted log archives we'll need a short kickoff with engineering to set retention windows.
3) KMS details: if you require dedicated key control using your KMS, we can discuss our BYOK pattern and HSM integrations.

If you can drop answers for data residency or any mandatory regulatory constraints, it will help me prepare targeted slides.

See you tomorrow.
Mina
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@novara.tech>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@novara.tech>, procurement@novara.tech
Date: 2026-10-14T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Architecture Review request for Redwood integration

Thanks everyone for a productive session — Mina and Diego, that cleared up most of our questions. Follow-ups from our side:
- I'll upload the completed questionnaire with a few clarifying comments by EOD Friday.
- Procurement asked for a short summary of the estimated committed spend for a Dedicated pool for 6 months; Jasmine, can you share a ballpark range and any available term discounts?
- We may request a short POC with a dedicated test environment; Sofia will coordinate access and a timeline after we finish internal approvals.

Attaching my notes from the call.

Best,
Alex
